evidence.finding: Lists 015 Cherry, 012 Rosewood and 007 Raspberry. Current generation does not establish an identity for code 030.

evidence.finding: Official search result lists 004 Coral and 020 Mahogany; full page fetch failed. Regional/generation differences require the actual package.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Cetaphil Daily Smoothing Moisturizer
evidence.finding: Rough and bumpy product describes 20% urea and body-area use; not sufficient to assert the stocked 296ml formula or face directions.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Cetaphil Exfoliating Rough & Bumpy Cream
evidence.finding: Current 8 fl oz cream is body-directed. It is not an automatic match to the workbook 296ml moisturizer.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Cetaphil 296ml regional product
evidence.finding: Official result has a 296ml anti-roughness cream; match barcode, country, formula and directions before using its attributes.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Vaseline body serums
evidence.finding: Super Vitamin Cranberry and Peach are in body serums; this supports body scope, not a specific stock variant.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Vaseline Super Vitamin Cranberry
evidence.finding: Official regional pack is 320ml and applied to the body; workbook is 360ml without the fruit variant. Do not substitute size or claims.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Soap & Glory RUSHOWER 200ml, Boots brand range
evidence.finding: 200ml dry shampoo with directions for hair roots supports a Hair Care branch. Manufacturer-domain exact page was not located.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Pixi On-the-Glow Blush
evidence.finding: Official listing identifies Fleur, Ruby and Juicy; propose Fleur spelling, keep separate SKUs until packages establish the same product family.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Tarte Shape Tape original concealer
evidence.finding: Official listing contains 12N fair neutral and 20S light sand. Confirm original formula and each pack size before family grouping.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: CeraVe Resurfacing Retinol Serum
evidence.finding: Product-specific description supports smoother texture, post-acne marks and visible pores. Do not turn marks into active-acne treatment.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%
evidence.finding: Product targets include visible shine, dryness, dullness and texture. FAQ explicitly describes blemish-prone suitability and fine lines; neither is approval for acne treatment or sensitive skin.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: The Ordinary Alpha Arbutin 2% + HA
evidence.finding: Product-specific description supports appearance of dark spots and uneven tone. Proposed spelling correction only; package formula must match.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: AXIS-Y Artichoke Intensive Skin Barrier Ampoule
evidence.finding: Product page separately identifies stressed/sensitive skin, beyond its barrier-support description. Confirm regional formula and packaging before concern approval.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: AXIS-Y Dark Spot Correcting Glow Serum
evidence.finding: Product-specific benefits address dark spots and post-acne marks, tone clarity and hydration. No active-acne treatment claim.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: e.l.f. Glow Reviver Slipstick
evidence.finding: Official product describes a lip oil stick; distinguish stick format from a liquid lip oil.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: e.l.f. product listing
evidence.finding: Lists Slipstick shade Vine & Shine. Search result is candidate evidence, not stock/package confirmation.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.title: Danessa Myricks Blurring Balm Powder Lowlighter
evidence.finding: Regional official product name supports a face lowlighter type; the workbook lacks a shade.
evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed

evidence.scope: Candidate product; physical inventory identity not confirmed
